tools.name: list_vector_skill_files
tools.title: List Vector Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the platform 'vector' skill, the platform's guidance for semantic search, RAG, and document ingestion against a platform vector database. Call this when the user asks about vector databases, embeddings, similarity or nearest-neighbor search, chunking, retrieval, RAG, or ingesting documents into a platform app, and when they name VectorDatabaseQuery, ListDocumentsInVectorDatabase, CreateEmbeddingsFromDocuments, CreateEmbeddingsFromVectorCSVFile, RemoveDocumentFromVectorDatabase, or MyEngines(engineTypes=["VECTOR"]). Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md. Not for raw SQL or graph queries (see the database skill) or for LLM calls without retrieval (see the model skill).

project.title: project
project.description: The vector skill (vector). Always this value.

tools.name: read_vector_skill_file
tools.title: Read Vector Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the platform 'vector' skill in full, for writing code that runs semantic search, manages documents in a vector index, or wires retrieved chunks into an LLM call for RAG. Pass filePath exactly as list_vector_skill_files reports it; SKILL.md is the main guide and covers the VectorDatabaseQuery usage pattern, metadata and source-document filtering, listing and adding documents, pre-chunked CSV ingestion, and the end-to-end RAG example.

project.title: project
project.description: The vector skill (vector). Always this value.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Path of the file to read, relative to the skill folder, as reported by list_vector_skill_files. Use 'SKILL.md' for the main guide.
